title: Thimsy ES-DE/nano/systems.json
description: Nano's systems on the card (esdeSystemsJson, NanoMenuXmb.cpp). The launch fields (launchType, coreSo, package, launchArgs, intentTemplate) are per device (OA-46): a writer keeps each existing system's launch fields exactly as it read them and writes its own only for a system it adds; a device's system picks are in its set's picks.json (LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.8, 4.25). The card's launch fields also name the system's card core for shared saves (OA-53, 4.17). Both platforms may write the other fields, the shared system list. The scraper accounts are never on the card: the scraper object allows only override and platform (OA-32 Q6). Unknown fields are allowed because the file is already in the field; Android rebuilds it from structs, so a field only Linux knows does not survive an Android save. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

launchType.description: Launch field (kept as read for an existing system; not a pick, LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.8).

coreSo.description: Launch field (kept as read for an existing system; not a pick, LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.8): <core>_libretro_android.so, or empty.

package.description: Launch field (kept as read for an existing system; not a pick, LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.8).

launchArgs.description: Launch field (kept as read for an existing system; not a pick, LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.8).

intentTemplate.description: Launch field (kept as read for an existing system; not a pick, LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.8): am start arguments with {file.uri} and the other tokens.

scraper.description: Only the per-system scraper choice; user, pass and key are device-only and never written here.

value.description: The card's own volume is written as %CARDID%.
